note: A protocol method IMPLEMENTATION overrides the method the same file DECLARES on that protocol. The old ruling — `defmethod` shares the multimethod's var identity, so source and target would be identical — is true of `defmethod` and was generalised to the language; the construct was measured (922 implementations, 239 published, over 633 corpus files) and the ruling does not survive it. Here the two endpoints are distinct var identities (`Sealed.close` the declaration, `Box.close` the implementation), so this is not the self-loop the old ruling was about. The join gate is the strict one: a method the protocol does not declare is NOT an override (Mismatch.toString against OnlyClose), and a `reify` implementation has no NAMED TYPE so no source identity can be published at all (the `f` in Holder.close).
